tiers.1: Ships in the TypeScript app. Computed in pass one and pass two. Appears in the student DOCX and the cohort CSV.
tiers.2: Python research layer. Computed from the archived transcript JSON. Appears in the research export only.
tiers.3: Python research layer. Needs the archived 48 kHz audio, forced alignment, or an acoustic toolkit. Appears in the research export only.
tiers.4: Needs people: annotation of a validation subset, stimulated recall, listener studies, or an extra task such as an L1 recording. Listed so the archive keeps what those studies need.

inputs.words: Word-level transcript with start, end, confidence, punctuated_word, channel, isFinal, pass.
inputs.alignment: Phone- and syllable-level timings from a forced aligner run on the archive.
inputs.roster: Pseudonymous participant IDs, consent status, course and unit metadata.
inputs.instructor: Instructor live score and later rubric scores, stored apart from student outputs.
inputs.rawAsr: Every Deepgram message, interim and final, both passes, stored verbatim.
inputs.verbatim: CrisperWhisper verbatim transcript per channel with word timestamps (research layer).
inputs.phones: Free phone recognition per channel (wav2vec2 eSpeak phone model) aligned to dictionary forms.
